rows.note: Use 埋 as the all-purpose choice for literally putting something under the ground or pressing it into or under a covering.

example.english: We need to bury a seed in the garden.
example.traditional: 我哋要喺花園埋粒種子。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 faa1 jyun4 maai4 nap1 zung2 zi2

rows.note: Choose 收埋 when the emphasis is on hiding something away, especially feelings, secrets, or something being concealed from view.

example.english: I had to bury this sadness deep in my heart.
example.traditional: 我將呢段傷心事收埋喺心底。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 ni1 dyun6 soeng1 sam1 si6 sau1 maai4 hai2 sam1 dai2

rows.note: Use 殺死 for the literal killing or murdering sense, rather than for physically putting something underground.

example.english: They bury the victim only after killing him.
example.traditional: 佢哋殺死個受害者之後，先至埋葬佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 saat3 sei2 go3 sau6 hoi6 ze2 zi1 hau6 sin1 zi3 maai4 zong3 keoi5

rows.note: Use 捱得耐過 B when saying that someone will survive or remain alive longer than B, usually in a comparison.

example.english: I think I’ll outlive him, so I won’t have to bury him first.
example.traditional: 我諗我捱得耐過佢，唔使我埋佢先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 ngo5 ngaai4 dak1 noi6 gwo3 keoi5 m4 sai2 ngo5 maai4 keoi5 sin1
